name: Norahog
body: I wear glasses throughout the day and keep wondering whether curtain bangs would crowd the area around my eyes. Most of my saved references use bare faces, which makes it harder to imagine the effect with my usual frames. I bookmarked a page during a search for [url=https://style-my-hair.top]blonde hair with curtain bangs[/url] and want to use references to start a discussion. I would compare where the shorter pieces end in relation to the top edge and outer corners of my frames. I also need to account for a small cowlick, which can move the parting away from the centre after washing. I would take my regular glasses to the appointment and bring references that show a range of possible fringe lengths. Being able to pin or tuck the fringe away would matter on mornings when I need to leave the house quickly. A cautious first length seems sensible to me, especially if I can decide later whether I want a more noticeable fringe. For people who wear glasses daily, which fringe details proved most useful to discuss at the consultation before having it cut?
